title: Replace hardcoded Color(0x...) literals with theme/AppColors tokens across gamification presentation widgets
rule: custom_lint no_color_literal_outside_theme (currently non-functional since dart run custom_lint crashes; not covered by any make audit grep)
why: 38 raw Color(0x...) literals across these 10 files bypass the design-token system entirely (contrast with achievement_unlock_celebration.dart:179-180, which correctly reuses AppColors.chartGreen/chartBlue in the same list). This is exactly the pattern the no_color_literal_outside_theme custom_lint rule exists to catch, but that lint currently can't run at all (custom_lint_core/analyzer version mismatch, already flagged by the orchestrator), so nothing today prevents new color literals from being added or flags the existing ones. Concrete cost: no single place to retheme/dark-mode this feature, and visually-identical colors (e.g. several near-duplicate blues/creams) are redefined independently per file instead of shared.
recommendation: Extract the repeated literals into named constants in core/theme/app_colors.dart (or reuse existing ones where a near-duplicate already exists) and reference those from all 10 files; once dart run custom_lint is repaired, let no_color_literal_outside_theme enforce this going forward.
acceptance_criteria: No lib/features/gamification/**/*.dart file (excluding generated) contains a Color(0x...) literal outside core/theme
no_color_literal_outside_theme reports zero violations in this feature once custom_lint is functional again
